item.title: F1 debuts a new track with a corner so grand it is called Monumental
item.description: Formula 1 debuts a new circuit to its calendar, and despite no grand prix raced yet, the Madring already boasts a corner that is poised to become an iconic scene in motorsport. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: Dozens of people have been rescued but scores remain missing following a fire aboard a Philippine ferry that has claimed a number of lives. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Gold Coast charity helping at-risk youth build tiny homes
